snippet.title: ARMY OF TWO Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 FULL GAME [4K ULTRA HD] -  No Commentary
snippet.description:
Army Of Two Walkthrough Part 1 and until the last part will include the full Army Of Two Gameplay on Xbox 360. This Army Of Two Gameplay is recorded in 4K 60FPS on Xbox 360 and will include the full game, all endings and all boss fights. 

Enjoy! 

If you liked the video please remember to leave a Like & Comment, I appreciate it a lot!

Army of Two is a third-person shooter video game developed and published by Electronic Arts. Focusing on cooperative strategies, Army of Two's main feature is the necessity to use coordinated teamwork to accomplish the game's goals.
